input.summary: Add a short licence sentence after Section 7.5(b) granting the Issuer and Depositor rights in the Servicer's servicing software, extended to their Affiliates on written notice and transferable to an M&A successor, leaving the existing Successor Servicer/third-party carve-out fully intact.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a licence to use the Servicer's servicing software and related applications, extended to our Affiliates on written notice and transferable to a successor by merger or acquisition, which is our fallback licence position. The Servicer's existing carve-out for Successor Servicers, third parties and restricted or confidential materials is left in place and is overridden only to the extent of this grant.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the preceding sentence, the Servicer grants the Issuer and the Depositor, and on written notice their respective Affiliates, a license to use its processes, procedures, models, servicing software and other applications as necessary to service, or to have serviced, the Receivables, which license is transferable to a successor of the Issuer or the Depositor by merger or acquisition.
